title: Chapter 2910 - 162: The Grand Earth Formation
content:
Chapter 2910: Chapter 162: The Grand Earth Formation

Although lacking high-rank cultivators above the Golden Core.

The numerous people and vast power, unwavering faith of the Divine Slave Tribe, subsequently became Mo Hua’s greatest support in "spreading the Dao" in the Great Wilderness.

They upheld their faith in the Lord of the Temple and their loyalty to the Shaman, actively spreading the teachings of the Divine Lord as interpreted by Mo Hua to the lowest levels of the Barbaric Wilderness, affecting the divine sense and cognition of many.

Having established the Divine Slave Tribe, Mo Hua finally had a "trusted" tribe of his own.

Among all the world’s beings, he finally had his own "foundation."

All those liberated from suffering in the Great Wilderness, were his followers as the "Divine Lord," and his supporters as the "Shaman."

This laid the groundwork for his future path of "Divine Sense Proving the Dao."

Using divine sense to perceive the Heavenly Dao and using formations to aid the suffering.

Yet at this time, Mo Hua was merely following his benevolence and Taoist Heart, not considering too deeply.

All cultivation, experiences, insights, and various thoughts emerging were only faintly fermenting in his Taoist Heart, slowly sprouting, and gradually hatching into the "Dao" over a long period...

...

With the establishment of the Divine Slave Tribe, the situation in the Barbaric Wilderness transformed dramatically, and its atmosphere refreshed swiftly.

Having control of the Divine Slave Tribe, Mo Hua now possessed his own "military force."

Although the Barbarian Slaves were cannon fodder, and high-rank Barbarian Cultivators were rare with weak combat power, the sheer numbers were ample.

The vast numbers, when gathered together, formed a formidable force.

Mo Hua as the Shaman, not only symbolized divine authority and manipulated faith, but also directly wielded political power, and held military power.

In the Barbaric Wilderness, at least presently in the whole Third Grade Vermilion Bird Mountain Realm, Mo Hua was the "God."

In every sense of the word.

And after Mo Hua’s unprecedented expansion of power, the first thing he did was construct the Large Formation.

Constructing a Large Formation required immense manpower and resources.

Especially in a place like the Barbaric Wilderness, where tribes were fragmented, power was contested, faith was chaotic, the people were wild, and resources scarce.

Almost no individual or force was qualified or had the ability to construct a Large Formation.

Except Mo Hua.

Especially now that he unified the Vermilion Bird Mountain Realm, achieving high unification of divine, political, and military powers, garnering the hearts of all the people in the name of the Divine Lord, Mo Hua’s personal authority reached unprecedented heights.

Aside from that, no one could gather all manpower and resources to undertake such a massive formation project akin to "labor and financial drain" in the remote Barbaric Wilderness.

Even if someone could concentrate power, they wouldn’t have the formation ability.

In the entire Cultivation World, those who can build Large Formations are incredibly rare even among genius Formation Masters.

Ordinarily, such individuals don’t appear in ordinary Barbaric Wilderness.

What’s more, this isn’t merely about "constructing a Large Formation."

Regular Formation Masters, especially Main Array Masters, build Large Formations following fixed "templates," based on optimized and inherited Large Formation Diagrams from ancestors and seniors.

One must have the Large Formation Diagram before "drawing the formation" to construct a large array.

But the Large Formation in front of us aims not to attack or defend, but to suppress the famine disaster, creating a stable place for the beings of the Great Wilderness amidst the despairing famine disaster.

This kind of formation has no "textbook."

There is no ready-made "standard answer" either.

Constructing a specific large formation to tackle a specific problem is yet another dimension of formation skill.

The current specific issue originates from the famine disaster spread by Gui Tao’s people.

The Main Array Masters of the Cultivation World, even if experienced, face such "out-of-scope" situations and mostly feel helpless fear.

With ready "answers," constructing according to the standard of a Large Formation is incredibly difficult.

Not to mention, now there isn’t even an "answer."

They might not even know where the famine disaster "problem" lies.

And the issuer is the terrifying and elusive Demon Sect Cultivator.

Ordinary Formation Masters cannot tackle this.

Even Mo Hua, having deeply studied the issue of famine disaster firsthand in the Great Wilderness.

Even having somewhat evolved and understood the laws related to the famine disaster.

Truly controlling the spread of the famine disaster using formations, to solve the current plight of the Great Wilderness, is still exceedingly difficult.

Firstly, "The famine disaster is a calamity artificially created by Uncle through some formation with Taotie’s Power." This conclusion is based on Mo Hua’s experience and judgment.

Though Mo Hua is seventy to eighty percent confident that’s the case.

Without personal verification, he cannot be entirely certain.

If Uncle’s "Famine Disaster Formation" exists, then the most thorough solution to the famine disaster is to dismantle this formation.

The issue is, even with Mo Hua’s current unified divine authority and high status, he still cannot ascertain the details of this "Famine Disaster Formation."

Uncle’s methods are unfathomable.

Mo Hua finds it difficult to trace Uncle’s actions.

Even if he found and obtained the complete Formation Diagram of the "Barbaric Wilderness Famine Disaster Formation," Mo Hua lacks the confidence to dismantle Uncle’s formation.

Indeed, Mo Hua does not dare to "destroy."

This scheme was laid by Uncle himself, and no one knows how deep his plotting runs.
